subject: Research interview: customer outcomes discussion (scheduling & recording consent)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily.tan@helixalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Research interview: customer outcomes discussion (scheduling & recording consent)

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with us. We're putting together a short discovery conversation to capture the outcomes Helixa Labs has seen using Redwood Inference and to surface a few success metrics for a potential customer story. High level: 30 minutes, a 5–7 minute run through of your deployment and outcomes, then a 20-minute Q&A.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 3, 10:00–10:30am
- Tue Nov 3, 2:00–2:30pm
- Wed Nov 4, 9:00–9:30am

If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do and we'll flex. We plan to record the session for internal note-taking and for a short edited clip if you approve — we will only publish anything with explicit written consent (we can share a one-page release).

Attached: a one-page agenda and the draft release form so you can review ahead of time.

Attendees from our side: me (Customer Marketing), Marissa (CS), and Priyom (Solutions). Would you like anyone else from Helixa on the call?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment stubs: 20261102-outcomes-interview-agenda.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), redwood-case-study-release-form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Emily Tan <emily.tan@helixalabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@helixalabs.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Research interview: customer outcomes discussion (scheduling & recording consent)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the note and for sending the agenda. We can do Tue Nov 3 at 2:00pm PST (that works for our product and analytics leads). 

A couple quick things:
- We'll need the release form emailed to our legal contact (I cc'd Carlos) for a quick review — nothing unusual but they like to confirm permissions.
- Recording is fine for internal use; if you plan to publish a clip on your site or socials, we'd need to approve the final edit. That's standard for us.
- For the agenda, can you add a brief section about performance/cost comparisons? Our execs like to see unit economics called out.

Attendees on our side will be me (Head of Product) and Carlos (Sr. Analyst). We may loop in a solutions engineer depending on time.

See you Tue at 2:00pm PST — please send the calendar invite and a meeting link.

Best,
Emily
Head of Product
Helixa Labs
emily.tan@helixalabs.com

Subject: Re: Research interview: customer outcomes discussion (scheduling & recording consent)

Hi Emily / Carlos —

Great — thanks for confirming. I've booked Tue Nov 3, 2:00–2:30pm PST and sent a calendar invite (link below). Agenda updated to include a 5-minute section on performance/cost comparisons; attached is the revised agenda.

Quick notes:
- Recording: we will record the session for internal notes by default. If Helixa wants to use any clips externally, we'll send the proposed edit and a one-page release for signature before publishing.
- Legal review: Carlos — appreciate you doing a quick pass. If you have suggested edits to the release form, please send them back and we'll incorporate.
- Prep request: if you can share a single slide or bullet list with 2–3 metrics (latency improvements, cost per inference, business impact) ahead of the call, we can reference it during the discussion.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-helixa-demo
Drive agenda: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xy-example-agenda

Thanks all — see you Tue.

Best,
Kimberly

Marissa / Priyom —

Quick internal: Helixa confirmed Tue at 2pm PST with two attendees. Carlos is reviewing the release form; he asked that we only publish clips after Helixa signs off. Please come ready to ask the outcome/cost questions (I noted the unit economics slot).

I've dropped the agenda in the shared drive and included a calendar link in the thread. We'll do a short pre-meet sync at 1:50pm PST to align on roles — I'll be the moderator, Marissa can lead adoption questions, Priyom can follow on technical/quantization notes.

Thanks — see you at 1:50pm.

Kimberly
